description:
FILED s522a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19) from the #3347 acceptance run (cz-03zlib-v1.t transpiles since #3061's sigil-exact count).

IO-Compress-2.214 t/cz-03zlib-v1.t now runs and ENDS CLEANLY (rc 0, no die, Test::NoWarnings' "no warnings" row is the last) after 400 of its 472 planned rows: 72 assertions are never emitted.  The file has no code after its last block (line 1280), so the missing rows are iterations of the test loops that run fewer times under PCL -- the candidates are the header-index loops at lines 1003-1117 (`for my $index (GZIP_MIN_HEADER_SIZE + 1 .. GZIP_MIN_HEADER_SIZE + GZIP_FEXTRA_HEADER_SIZE + 1)`, `... + length($Name) - 1`, `... + length($Comment) - 1`, `foreach my $trim (-8 .. -1)`), whose bounds come from IO::Compress::Gzip::Constants and from strings built earlier.

NO PERL ORACLE ON THIS BOX: real perl cannot run the file here (`Compress::Raw::Zlib version 2.214 required--this is only version 2.212`), so the per-section count must be read from the source.  NEXT STEP: print a counter before each of those loops under PCL and compare with the counts the source implies.  Output: scratch/s522a/cz03full.out in the s522a worktree.


=== DONE (s539a) -- the cause is #4881 (filed and fixed in the same batch) ===
`BEGIN { use_ok('IO::Compress::Gzip::Constants') }` imports `()` constants PCL's parse never saw: `GZIP_MIN_HEADER_SIZE + 1 .. N` was a call swallowing `+ 1 .. N`, so the four header-truncation loops ran once (72 rows).  A perl oracle was built in scratch (Compress-Raw-Zlib 2.214: scratch/s539a/cz03.perl, perl 472 rows).  Fixed by the import-directive fact (#4881): IO-Compress cz-03zlib-v1.t 400/0 of 472 rc 255 -> 472/0 of 472 rc 0 (= perl); the *PLAN* row LEFT the board baseline by edit.  No other IO-Compress baseline row was found wrong by the oracle.
CLOSE-WITH-ROWS: no board row is keyed #3619 any more.
